title: AMC 10 Scoring and Strategy: Why 14 Right Can Beat 16
description:
Does scoring 16 right beat 14 right? On the AMC 10 it can go the other way! Vantee explains how the AMC 10 is scored, when to guess and when to leave a question blank, and how to plan your test day.
A friendly guide for students and parents, with a quick AMC 10-style question to try at the end.

0:00 Intro
0:16 What is the AMC 10?
0:39 Format and scoring
1:25 Why 100 matters
1:55 To guess or not to guess
2:45 Test-day plan
